intro: Explore Majorca (Mallorca), from Palma’s historic streets to sandy beaches, mountain villages and scenic coastal walks. Save your plans, favourites, photos and holiday spending on your device.

areas.name: Palma
areas.description: Island capital with a historic centre, waterfront and cathedral.

areas.name: Alcúdia & Port d’Alcúdia
areas.description: Walled old town, broad sandy bay and family-friendly seafront.

areas.name: Sóller & Port de Sóller
areas.description: Mountain town and sheltered harbour connected by a historic tram.

areas.name: Pollença & Port de Pollença
areas.description: Old town squares, beaches and access to the north coast.

areas.name: Cala d’Or
areas.description: Southeast resort known for small coves and a marina.

areas.name: Valldemossa
areas.description: Stone village in the Tramuntana mountains.

attractions.name: Palma Cathedral (La Seu)
attractions.description: Gothic cathedral beside the waterfront; check entry and visiting hours.

attractions.name: Bellver Castle
attractions.description: Circular hilltop castle with views over Palma.

attractions.name: Alcúdia Old Town
attractions.description: Explore medieval walls, lanes and the town centre.

attractions.name: Cap de Formentor
attractions.description: Dramatic northern headland; seasonal road restrictions may apply.

attractions.name: Cuevas del Drach
attractions.description: Show caves near Porto Cristo; check tours and booking details.

attractions.name: Sa Calobra & Torrent de Pareis
attractions.description: Mountain road and coastal gorge; access and walking conditions vary.

transport.name: Walking
transport.description: Old towns and promenades are walkable, but some streets are steep or cobbled.

transport.name: TIB buses
transport.description: Island-wide public transport; verify routes and fares with TIB.

transport.name: EMT Palma buses
transport.description: City bus network for Palma; check current routes and fares.

transport.name: Car hire
transport.description: Useful for remote coves; check parking, mountain roads and restrictions.

transport.name: Train & tram
transport.description: Palma–Sóller heritage railway and Sóller harbour tram have separate schedules and tickets.

useful.name: Emergency services
useful.description: Call 112 in an emergency in Spain.

useful.name: Weather & sun
useful.description: Carry water and sun protection; check heat alerts and local forecasts.

useful.name: Swimming safety
useful.description: Follow beach flags and lifeguard instructions; avoid unsafe sea conditions.

useful.name: Currency
useful.description: Euro (€). Check payment and cash withdrawal fees.

useful.name: Travel documents
useful.description: Check UK government advice for Spain and your travel insurance.

useful.name: Language
useful.description: Spanish and Catalan (Mallorquí) are widely used; English is common in tourist areas.

beaches.name: Playa de Muro
beaches.description: Long sandy beach on Alcúdia Bay; check flags and sea conditions.

beaches.name: Port d’Alcúdia Beach
beaches.description: Wide sandy bay with a long seafront.

beaches.name: Cala Mondragó
beaches.description: Coves in a protected natural area; parking can be limited.

beaches.name: Cala Agulla
beaches.description: Sandy bay near Cala Ratjada, backed by pine trees.

beaches.name: Es Trenc
beaches.description: Long sandy beach in a protected coastal landscape; follow local access rules.

markets.name: Sineu Market
markets.description: Traditional inland market; check current market day and hours.

markets.name: Alcúdia Market
markets.description: Market in and around the old town; verify days locally.

markets.name: Inca Shopping
markets.description: Explore shops and leather-goods heritage in this inland town.

markets.name: Palma Shopping
markets.description: Boutiques, markets and shopping streets around the centre.

nightlife.name: Palma Old Town
nightlife.description: Restaurants, cocktail bars and evening terraces.

nightlife.name: Santa Catalina, Palma
nightlife.description: Lively neighbourhood for dining and evening venues.

nightlife.name: Port d’Alcúdia
nightlife.description: Waterfront restaurants and relaxed evening bars.

family.name: Palma Aquarium
family.description: Marine exhibits and activities; check tickets and opening hours.

family.name: Alcúdia Bay
family.description: Shallow-water beach areas; always supervise children and check flags.

family.name: Sóller Historic Train
family.description: Scenic rail journey between Palma and Sóller; book/check schedules.

family.name: Caves of Drach
family.description: Guided cave visit; check accessibility and tour conditions.

family.name: Beach & promenade day
family.description: Choose a nearby beach and plan shade, water and sun protection.

dining.name: Palma Old Town
dining.description: Explore tapas bars and Mallorcan cooking in the historic centre.

dining.name: Santa Catalina Market Area
dining.description: Food market and surrounding cafés; check opening hours.

dining.name: Alcúdia Old Town
dining.description: Cafés and restaurants in the walled town.

dining.name: Try local dishes
dining.description: Look for tumbet, pa amb oli and ensaïmada; check ingredients if needed.

daytrips.name: Valldemossa & Deià
daytrips.description: Mountain villages and scenic roads; check bus and parking options.

daytrips.name: Sóller & Port de Sóller
daytrips.description: Historic train and tram, town centre and harbour.

daytrips.name: Cap de Formentor
daytrips.description: Coastal viewpoints; check seasonal shuttle and vehicle restrictions.

daytrips.name: Alcúdia & Pollença
daytrips.description: Historic centres, northern beaches and viewpoints.
